Meta.title: Pairly
Meta.description: AI does the work. You make the call. Together.

Common.tagline: AI does the work. You make the call. Together.

Org.label: Organisation
Org.noneHint: You are not in any organisation yet.

Command.title: Command menu
Command.description: Search for a page or an action.
Command.placeholder: Type a page or an action
Command.hint: Press {keys} any time to open this menu.

Auth.signInSubtitle: We email you a link. No password needed.
Auth.footnote: By signing in you agree to keep candidate and vendor data private.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: That link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
errors.EXPIRED_TOKEN: That link has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.new_user_signup_disabled: This email has no Pairly account. Ask your admin for an invite.
errors.originMismatch: This address ({origin}) is not trusted by the auth server. Open Pairly at the address in BETTER_AUTH_URL, or add this origin to PAIRLY_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS. You only see this message in development.

CheckEmail.title: Check your email
CheckEmail.body: We sent a sign-in link to {email}.
CheckEmail.bodyNoEmail: We sent you a sign-in link.
CheckEmail.expires: The link works once and expires in 5 minutes.
CheckEmail.devHint: Running locally? Open Mailpit at localhost:8025.

Confirm.title: Finish signing in
Confirm.body: Select the button to sign in on this device.
Confirm.missing: This link is incomplete. Ask for a new one.
Confirm.why: We ask for this click so that email scanners cannot use your link.

TwoFactor.verifyBody: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6 digit code for Pairly.
TwoFactor.invalid: That code did not work. Check the time on your phone and try again.
TwoFactor.expired: This sign-in has expired. Start again.
TwoFactor.setupBody: Add a code from an authenticator app each time you sign in. Admins and approvers will need this.
TwoFactor.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app.
TwoFactor.manual: Or enter this key by hand:
TwoFactor.backupBody: Each code works once. Keep them somewhere safe. You will not see them again.
TwoFactor.freshSession: For your safety, sign in again before changing this.

Home.emptyBody: New approvals, flags and drafts will show up here first.

NotProvisioned.title: Your account is not set up yet
NotProvisioned.body: You are signed in as {email}. You can see work in Pairly once you join an organisation, and you join one by accepting an invitation from its admin.
NotProvisioned.step1: Ask your Pairly admin to send an invitation to this email address.
NotProvisioned.step2: Open the link in the invitation email and accept it. You will land here, ready to work.

Unavailable.title: We cannot reach Pairly right now
Unavailable.body: Your work is safe. Try again in a moment.

Placeholder.title: {section} is on its way
Placeholder.body: This area arrives in a later release. Home shows anything that needs you.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: The page you asked for does not exist or has moved.

magicLink.subject: Your Pairly sign-in link
magicLink.body: Use the link below to sign in to Pairly.
magicLink.expires: The link works once and expires in {minutes} minutes.
magicLink.ignore: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.

invitation.subject: {inviter} invited you to {org} on Pairly
invitation.body: {inviter} invited you to join {org} on Pairly as {role}. Use the link below to accept.
invitation.expires: The link works once, only for this email address, and expires in {days} days.
invitation.ignore: If you were not expecting this, you can ignore this email.

Invite.title: Join {org}
Invite.body: You are invited to join {org} on Pairly as {role}.
Invite.signInHint: We send the link to the invited address. Open it on this device to continue.
Invite.wrongUserTitle: This invitation is for someone else
Invite.wrongUser: You are signed in as {current}, but this invitation is for {email}. Sign out, then open the link again.
Invite.invalid: It may have expired, been used already, or been withdrawn. Ask your admin to send a new one.

errors.invitation_invalid: This invitation cannot be used any more. Ask your admin for a new one.
errors.invitation_email_mismatch: This invitation was sent to a different email address.
errors.email_not_verified: Sign in with the invited email address first.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

Members.title: Members
Members.subtitle: People in {org} and their roles. New people join by invitation.
Members.inviteBody: They get an email with a link that works once, for 7 days, and only for that address.
Members.notEmailed: The invitation was created but the email could not be sent. Share this link with {email} yourself:
Members.readOnly: You can see members. Ask an admin to invite people or change roles.

errors.invalid_input: Check the email address and role.
errors.invitation_pending: This person already has a pending invitation.
errors.already_member: This person already has this role.
errors.second_factor_required: Sign in with two-factor authentication to invite people.
errors.invitation_closed: This invitation is no longer pending.

SecondFactor.setupBody: Your role lets you approve, decide or manage. Pairly asks for a code from an authenticator app before you can do that.
SecondFactor.reauthTitle: Sign in again with your code
SecondFactor.reauthBody: Two-factor is on, but this session started without a code. Sign in again and enter the code from your authenticator app.
SecondFactor.reauthAction: Sign out and sign in again
SecondFactor.canStill: You can still read everything your role allows.

Settings.subtitle: Manage your organisation and your account.
Settings.membersBody: See who is in your organisation and invite people.
Settings.securityBody: Two-step sign-in with an authenticator app.

BackupCode.title: You signed in with a backup code
BackupCode.remaining: {count, plural, =0 {You have no backup codes left.} one {You have # backup code left.} other {You have # backup codes left.}} Use your authenticator app next time.
BackupCode.unknown: That code is now used up. Use your authenticator app next time.

Unsubscribe.valid: You will no longer get {category} emails from Pairly. Other emails and in-app notifications stay on.
Unsubscribe.done: We will not send you these emails any more. You can turn them back on in settings.
Unsubscribe.expired: Unsubscribe links work for 60 days. Sign in to manage which emails you get.
Unsubscribe.invalid: It may be incomplete or changed. Sign in to manage which emails you get.
Unsubscribe.unavailable: We could not reach Pairly just now. Try again later, or sign in to manage which emails you get.
Unsubscribe.manage: Sign in to manage email settings
